No. Of the 81.3 hectares of 2021 tree-cover loss counted as an event, 68.1 hectares were within mapped pine plantation and 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest, according to the 2021 MGAP forest map. None was mapped as native forest.

A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event; its forest type is not specified.
